name: gather
title: Go and gather something by hand
description: Walks to the nearest patch of whatever it is asked for and hand-mines until it is carrying the amount wanted, or the patch runs out. Every mine-* directive is this one with the resource filled in.

resource.description: entity to mine: coal, iron-ore, copper-ore, stone

kind.description: "name" for an ore, "type" for things like trees

amount.description: how much to come back with

reach.description: how far to look; the map has to be explored that far
